evidence_categories.SOFTWARE_COORDINATE_SEMANTICS: MA2 software definitions only; not Show sign mapping or venue orientation.
evidence_categories.CURRENT_SHOW_MACHINE_FACTS: Facts read from fingerprint-bound Phase A snapshot or current read-only scanner, with identity match stated explicitly.
evidence_categories.VENUE_OPERATOR_FACTS: Operator assertions scoped to the current Test Show; not universal MA2 rules.

sources.title: XYZ
sources.scope: States virtual-channel Stage X horizontal, Stage Y toward/away from audience, and Stage Z vertical. Does not establish signed venue mapping for this Show.

sources.title: Position fixtures in virtual 3D stage
sources.scope: Fixture Pos X/Y/Z and Rot X/Y/Z act in the MA2 3D environment; Stage Axis and Object Axis are distinct controls. The reviewed text does not establish units for the exact fixture Pos fields or this venue's sign mapping.

fact_evidence.COORDINATE_FRAME_VERIFIED: The Phase A scanner records numeric fixture/subfixture Pos and Rot fields in its identified MA2 3D coordinate frame; physical venue axes, signs, and units are not implied.
fact_evidence.CURRENT_SHOW_FINGERPRINT_MATCHES_LIVE_SC: NO. Phase A fingerprint is b41d801b915cddfdd5017df787ad66b55941fbce415ab02ee8ec63acaa027bd5; the later local scanner identity is 145be3835bf8d23cf4cb416535a7313d90240077954594e33c4c995337023340. The exact-identity guard stopped FixtureType export before it ran.
fact_evidence.GEOMETRY_BEARING_RESOURCES_AVAILABLE: The fingerprint-bound Phase A snapshot contains 64 accepted non-protected fixture geometry placements; original 65 records include protected Fixture 9999.
fact_evidence.PROTECTED_RESOURCES_IDENTIFIED: Phase A marks Fixture 9999 PROTECTED_UNAVAILABLE; it is excluded from artistic placement resources.
fact_evidence.MA2_X_AXIS_CONCEPT: Official MA Lighting grandMA2 XYZ help defines Stage X as horizontal. This is software semantics only.
fact_evidence.MA2_Y_AXIS_CONCEPT: Official MA Lighting grandMA2 XYZ help defines Stage Y as toward/away from audience. This does not define a current-Show sign.
fact_evidence.MA2_Z_AXIS_CONCEPT: Official MA Lighting grandMA2 XYZ help defines Stage Z as vertical. This does not define physical height units for scanned fixture Pos fields.
fact_evidence.CURRENT_SHOW_X_SIGN_MAPPING: UNKNOWN. Neither generic MA2 semantics nor the supplied Pan/Tilt convention establishes a signed fixture Pos X mapping for this Show.
fact_evidence.CURRENT_SHOW_Y_SIGN_MAPPING: UNKNOWN. Neither generic MA2 semantics nor the supplied Pan/Tilt convention establishes a signed fixture Pos Y mapping for this Show.
fact_evidence.CURRENT_SHOW_Z_SIGN_MAPPING: UNKNOWN. Neither generic MA2 semantics nor the supplied Pan/Tilt convention establishes a signed fixture Pos Z mapping for this Show.
fact_evidence.COORDINATE_UNITS_VERIFIED: UNKNOWN. The reviewed official Fixture Position help did not explicitly assign units to the exact scanned fixture Pos X/Y/Z fields; units of other MA2 XYZ features are not extrapolated.
fact_evidence.STAGE_VIEW_CAPTURE_SUPPORTED: NO supported read-only Stage View image-capture method exists in the inspected ZEN scanner path; no undocumented command was attempted.
fact_evidence.STAGE_VIEW_EVIDENCE_INPUT_SUPPORTED: YES. A versioned, explicit operator-supplied image artifact can be validated by fingerprint, path containment, media signature, and SHA-256; it does not itself promote visual observations to physical facts.
fact_evidence.STAGE_VIEW_IMAGE_AVAILABLE: NO operator-supplied Stage View image is present in this calibration artifact.
fact_evidence.STAGE_BOUNDS_KNOWN: UNKNOWN. Fixture coordinate extrema are not stage bounds.
fact_evidence.PERFORMER_ZONE_KNOWN: UNKNOWN. Fixture coordinates do not identify the performance area.
fact_evidence.AUDIENCE_DIRECTION_KNOWN: The operator verified negative tilt as audience-facing within the current Show Pan/Tilt convention only. This does not map the Stage View or Pos X/Y/Z frame.
fact_evidence.UPSTAGE_DOWNSTAGE_KNOWN: PARTIAL only: positive tilt is described as upstage OR inward, which does not disambiguate upstage and cannot map to Pos Y or another XYZ sign.
fact_evidence.STAGE_LEFT_RIGHT_KNOWN: The operator verified Pan negative as stage right and Pan positive as stage left when facing the stage from the audience. This applies only to Pan orientation, not Pos X sign.
fact_evidence.FIXTURE_MOUNTING_POSITIONS_KNOWN: UNKNOWN. Fixture-object coordinates do not establish physical mounting/support positions.
fact_evidence.FIXTURE_ORIENTATION_WRITABLE: NOT_TESTED; this gate is read-only and does not authorize orientation or geometry writes.
fact_evidence.FIXTURE_ORIENTATION_READABLE: PARTIAL_NUMERIC_ROTATION_ONLY; Phase A contains numeric Rot X/Y/Z without venue-facing interpretation.
fact_evidence.OBSTRUCTION_DATA_AVAILABLE: NOT_AVAILABLE in the inspected current Show snapshot and profile.
fact_evidence.TRUSS_OR_SUPPORT_GEOMETRY_AVAILABLE: NOT_AVAILABLE in the inspected current Show snapshot and profile.
fact_evidence.CURRENT_FINGERPRINT_CAPABILITY_PROFILES_: NO for the Phase A fingerprint. A supported loopback onPC FixtureType profile reader exists, but its whole-Show identity precondition failed against the current local scan; no mismatched profile was bound.
fact_evidence.PAN_TILT_ORIENTATION_SEMANTICS: Operator-supplied and verified for this current Test Show convention only; it is not a universal grandMA2 rule and is explicitly independent of XYZ sign mapping.
fact_evidence.OPERATOR_PAN_TILT_CALIBRATION: Explicit operator instruction supplied for this SHEESH Test Show calibration gate; it is not promoted as a global MA2 convention.

operator_supplied_pan_tilt_calibration.scope: Current SHEESH Test Show and this operator's Pan/Tilt convention only; not a universal grandMA2 rule.
